title: Beyond Discrepancy: Oracle Drift in Nonstationary Weighted Risk Minimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.13598v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We analyze distributional drift in nonstationary weighted risk minimization by decomposing the excess risk into estimation, drift, and approximation components. The drift error is commonly bounded through discrepancy-type quantities that control changes of the risk over classes of predictors. We instead relate the drift error directly to the movement of the best predictor within the model class and analyze its behavior in parametrized regression models. Our analysis shows that discrepancy-type quantities can be overly conservative: unlike our oracle drift, they may scale at a larger order than the resulting excess-risk contribution and can respond to changes in the risk surface that do not affect the optimal predictor. For linear regression, we characterize this gap sharply and combine the resulting drift bounds with estimation guarantees. We further extend the analysis to nonparametric regression.

translated_title: 超越差异度量：非平稳加权风险最小化中的最优预测器漂移
translated_abstract: 我们通过将超额风险分解为估计、漂移和近似三个组成部分，来分析非平稳加权风险最小化中的分布漂移问题。漂移误差通常通过差异型量来界定，这类量控制预测器类别上风险的变化。与之不同，我们直接将漂移误差与模型类内最优预测器的移动联系起来，并分析其在参数化回归模型中的行为。我们的分析表明，差异型量可能过于保守：与我们的最优预测器漂移不同，它们可能以比相应的超额风险贡献更大的阶数增长，并且会对不影响最优预测器的风险面变化产生响应。对于线性回归，我们精确地刻画了这一差距，并将由此得到的漂移界与估计保证相结合。我们还进一步将分析扩展到非参数回归。
tldr: 该论文提出用模型类内最优预测器的移动（即“最优预测器漂移”）来直接刻画非平稳加权风险最小化中的漂移误差，证明传统差异型界过于保守，并在线性回归和非参数回归中得到了更精确的漂移界。
